selection_method.statement: Mechanical: candidates and inclusion are computed by tools/derive_synonyms.py from an independent FY2024 RePORTER corpus retrieved with verbatim NITRD scope phrases (scope/synonym_seeds.v1.json). The corpus excludes the 480 fixture projects and every record sharing a core project number with them. No term was chosen by hand, and the 480 texts, fixture suggestions and held-out key were not read. Replaces v1, whose candidates came from term frequency in the 480 (withdrawn).

provenance_policy: Each entry's 'expands' lists the verbatim NITRD scope phrases that retrieved the documents; 'reason' gives the statistic that admitted it. SME review may flag entries with 'sme_review'; flagged entries are excluded from the AI gate.
